# Spark Lane

> Spark Lane (sparklane.dev) is Emma Lane's personal website covering software engineering, accessibility, research, writing, and personal interests.

Spark Lane is a static Astro site with selected content managed through Contentful. It includes technical writing, portfolio work, dissertation research, and a Digital Garden of recommendations and guides.

## Main sections

- [Home](https://sparklane.dev/): Overview of the site and latest additions.
- [About Emma Lane](https://sparklane.dev/about/): Background, interests, skills, and contact information.
- [Blog posts](https://sparklane.dev/blog-posts/): Technical posts, personal notes, accessibility thoughts, and development updates.
- [Portfolio](https://sparklane.dev/portfolio/): Selected software engineering projects and practical builds.
- [Dissertation research](https://sparklane.dev/dissertation/): Research and dissertation updates.
- [Digital Garden](https://sparklane.dev/digital-garden/): Personal collections and curated notes.

## Digital Garden

- [Gaming](https://sparklane.dev/digital-garden/gaming/): Gaming guides and notes.
- [Listening](https://sparklane.dev/digital-garden/listening/): Music and podcast recommendations.
- [Reading](https://sparklane.dev/digital-garden/reading/): Book reviews and reading lists.
- [Recipes](https://sparklane.dev/digital-garden/recipes/): Personal recipes and cooking notes.
- [Watching](https://sparklane.dev/digital-garden/watching/): Film and television recommendations.

## Accessibility

- [Accessibility statement](https://sparklane.dev/accessibility-statement/): Accessibility approach, known limitations, feedback, and alternative-format requests.

The site aims to follow relevant WCAG 2.2 principles. No formal independent WCAG conformance claim has been made. Accessibility issues can be reported to emma@sparklane.dev.

## About the site

- Built with Astro, React, TypeScript, and SCSS.
- Content is partly managed through Contentful.
- Hosted as a static site at sparklane.dev.
- Content and recommendations represent Emma Lane's personal views and interests.
